coverAlt.id: Rumah dua lantai kontemporer dengan atap hip, fasad berlapis batu, dan hatchback merah terparkir di depan
coverAlt.en: Two-storey contemporary house with a hip roof, stone-clad facade and a red hatchback parked in front

description.id: Berlokasi di Padang, desain ini mengusung pendekatan arsitektur yang mengutamakan kemewahan modern melalui harmonisasi material premium dan permainan geometri berani. Dari fasad eksterior kontemporer yang didominasi garis-garis tegas hingga ruang tamu megah berinti tinggi dengan aksen marmer dan elemen emas yang memberi kesan bergengsi, estetika ini dipadukan dengan fungsi publik yang fleksibel lewat panel kayu vertikal dan pencahayaan tak langsung hangat, menciptakan transisi ruang yang elegan namun tetap terasa nyaman dan organik.
description.en: Located in Padang, this design features an architectural approach that prioritizes modern luxury through the harmonization of premium materials and bold geometric play. From a contemporary exterior facade dominated by strong lines to a grand living room interior with a high void and marble accents and gold elements that give a prestigious impression, this aesthetic is combined with flexible public functionality through the use of vertical wooden panels and warm indirect lighting, creating an elegant spatial transition that still feels comfortable and organic.
